historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures y text without validating fixed entry boundaries, minimum content size or x-by-y table span.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds format-aware bounds validation but lowers capability for pending descriptor policy inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify the Type 15 descriptor length y is the approved fixed size for every supported log-type descriptor, is sufficient for the defined event-type/data-format fields, makes the x-entry table fit exactly within the formatted structure and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture raw structure length, x, y and all descriptor bytes; validate y against the applicable descriptor layout, slice every entry on y-byte boundaries, check x-by-y span/remainder and repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves y and the descriptor format/OEM policy plus reboot plan. No raw event-log access or mutation is required.
required_inputs: Expected descriptor length y in bytes
Applicable standard or OEM descriptor field layout/minimum size
Expected descriptor count x and Type 15 formatted length
Policy for x=0, y=0, padding and extra OEM bytes
Raw-capable parser plus approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read Type 15 metadata only; do not clear/write/inject logs.
Preserve raw y and apply it uniformly to table slicing; do not infer variable lengths unless the authoritative format explicitly says so.
Use overflow-safe x-by-y arithmetic and ensure every descriptor stays within the formatted structure.
Do not decode bytes beyond the defined minimum under an unknown OEM format; retain them raw.
Stop on zero/undersized y contrary to policy, truncation/remainder, format ambiguity or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate raw y, minimum/format constraints, fixed entry boundaries and x-by-y table fit, then compare pre/post reboot.
Do not parse unknown OEM extensions beyond safe boundaries, mutate logs or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve descriptor y, standard/OEM layout and padding/zero-count rules.
Approve reboot/recovery, provide custom descriptor documentation where required and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The declared y is relevant, but a grep fragment cannot prove units, minimum format size, uniform entry boundaries or table fit.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw/decoded Type 15 data and report x, y, formatted length, per-entry byte ranges, defined-field minimum, padding/remainder and any truncation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The descriptor length y scope, Type 15 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate y against the approved descriptor layout, slice the raw table into exactly x fixed-size entries, prove bounds/remainder and retain undefined extension bytes without speculative decoding.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 15 records containing supported log type descriptors.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, descriptor specification and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 15 descriptor-length/table layout, authoritative OEM descriptor definition if any and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds byte-accurate minimum size, entry boundaries and x-by-y structure validation to the decoded y value.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Increases coverage for zero/undersized y, boundary drift, unexpected padding and truncated tables.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Expected y and standard/OEM descriptor format.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A structurally valid descriptor length does not establish that all advertised event types are emitted or that log records are decodable.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a larger y for documented OEM extensions, but must retain the standard fields and raw extension bytes and version x/y/list together; undocumented size changes remain pending confirmation.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/firmware identity, expected x/y, descriptor format and padding/OEM policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 15 structure with length, x, y and descriptor bytes
Minimum-size, per-entry boundary, x-by-y span, remainder/padding and truncation results
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot table diff without clearing logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The y field has clear fixed-table semantics when evaluated with x, format and structure length.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Length/bound checks are safely automatable; unknown extension meaning is an input and need not block raw validation.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds units/minimum, fixed boundaries, table span and OEM extension preservation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains format/bounds safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates custom extension interpretation and engineer verdict from structural execution.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible y value from passing when it is too small for defined fields or causes truncated/misaligned descriptor entries.
independent_technical_reasoning: y and x define fixed raw entry boundaries within a known structure length; size and bounds validation are deterministic software operations.
